description: Assimilate Gauntlet derived state and encounter resolution onto canonical SITREP state plus shared Phase 2 primitives, without runtime registration or presentation effects.
planning_goal: Complete SITREP Phase 3A Gauntlet. Create a canonical Gauntlet derived-state module that preserves weighted standing counts, weighted control-zone counts, enemy-elimination victory, unassailable-control victory, and final-round zone-control semantics. Delegate Region resolution/membership through the Phase 2 SITREP spatial delegation boundary and reuse canonical combatant/control/round primitives. Create a canonical Gauntlet resolution module that reads and mutates only through the Phase 1 SITREP state service, returns semantic output intents instead of creating ChatMessage or DOM effects, and performs no Hooks/runtime registration. Do not import the legacy SITREP kernel or tracker. Mark Gauntlet resolution MIGRATED_UNVERIFIED and Phase 3A complete only.
